VI.description: Build tool of the RemoteVI examples (source\3A tools\5Cdev\5Caixml\5Cgen_style_panel.py). Restyles the front panel of a composed VI in place and saves it\3A the composer only makes generic controls. Run it once on a freshly composed VI (or on one whose controls are all still top-level)\2C with the VI idle. Steps\3A (1) every row with a Ctl is Replaced by that .ctl under Silver (a path relative to vi.lib\5Csilver_ctls\2C e.g. Numeric\5CKnob NI_Silver.ctl)\3B wires\2C data type\2C enum items and default value stay. (2) Tabs\3A each tab control gets as many pages as Pages names (Add Page)\2C the page labels\2C and fixed tabs of Tab Width\3B with Width above 0 the control - also one that is no tab control\2C such as a subpanel - is sized through its own pane (Set Scaling Scale Single Object\2C the window grown by the difference\2C scaling off again). (3) every row\3A moved onto page Page of the tab control Tab (Left/Top relative to the tab control) or\2C with Tab empty and Pane 0 or more\2C into that pane of the panel (Left/Top in pane coordinates)\2C otherwise placed at Left/Top\3B Width/Height (0\3A keep) set the size of a string\2C button\2C numeric\2C the visible area of a multicolumn listbox and the plot area of a graph\3B Text sets a boolean\27s text (and centres it)\3B Tip the tip strip\3B Show Label and Visible. (4) Window sets the panel bounds and the origin to 0\2C0. Controls are found anywhere on the panel by label (Find Controls). problems lists every row whose steps returned an error\2C with the code\3B the run goes on.
